title: The growth that compounds
hook: Two stated cases: explore the horizon of compound growth.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the horizon of compound growth affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Balance, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the horizon of compound growth in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
